frameRule: Keep ranges are [from, to) frames of the clip at fps; everything else is cut.
method: Word gaps of at least 0.4 s from the S7V-026 transcript (talking-head-01.transcript.json), with 0.1 s of air kept next to each word, cut only when the gap's sound is at least 6 dB below the speech level (power mean over the word frames, from silence.detect).

Made with a separate script, not the app's planner, then reviewed against the hand-marked words (talking-head-01.words.json): the two gaps the level test keeps hold the words 'request' (2264-2272) and 'encyclopedia' (2736-2755), which the transcriber missed.
Not yet reviewed by ear: the PO should play each cut and confirm no word is clipped.

keptLoudGaps.note: [from, to, dB relative to speech] of gaps over 0.4 s left in because they are loud
